card.name: Ordinal ending before the word century
card.fires_on: The last piece of a century ordinal such as nineteenth, 17th or fifteenth, right before the word century. It is common in historical text.

modes.label: Spelled-out ordinals
modes.description: The ending of a spelled-out century, such as -enth or -teenth, after mid, late or early.
modes.example: China's strategy to mitigate undesirable cultural transfer through selective assimilation has been in place since the mid-ninete<<enth>> century.

modes.label: Numeric ordinals
modes.description: The th after a century number like 17 or 13.
modes.example: The collection is particularly strong in 17<<th>> century French history books

card.plain: It fires on the ending of a century name like 17th or nineteenth, just before the word century.
